What it measures (Aim 1 network metric): Mean inhibitory-unit firing rate (spikes/s) across units labeled `I`
Notes: Included as a population-level excitability constraint

What it measures (Aim 1 network metric): Mean excitatory-unit firing rate (spikes/s) across units labeled `E`
Notes: Helps anchor baseline E activity magnitude

What it measures (Aim 1 network metric): Number of excitatory units that fired (count of `E` units with ≥1 spike)
Number of inhibitory units that fired (count of `I` units with ≥1 spike)
Ratio of total E spikes / total I spikes (dimensionless)
Notes: Useful when matching overall E vs I contribution

What it measures (Aim 1 network metric): Baseline level of the convolved “mega-burst” population signal (units depend on convolution normalization)
Mega-burst frequency (bursts/s) detected on the population signal
Mega-burst amplitude on the population signal (convolved units)
